title: NNutty Spanish Cherry Pilaf
description: A fresh, creamy Mediterranean dish featuring dried cherries in a bhuna sauce for a light and romantic meal.

ingredients.name: 1 small bell pepper, finely chopped (optional)
ingredients.notes: Use for added color and sweetness.

instructions: Heat butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add dried cherries and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in olive oil and let simmer for another minute.
If using onion and bell pepper, add at this point and stir well for 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve immediately as a side dish or over rice for an extra meal.
Optional: garnish with fresh herbs like parsley or mint before serving.
